summary: Heavily obfuscated index.js with incomplete behavioral analysis
details: The package's index.js is heavily obfuscated, exhibiting classic string-array shuffling patterns (while(!![]) loop with repeated ['shift']() calls and large hex offsets) that hide the underlying code from straightforward inspection. Obfuscation alone is not proof of malicious intent — minifiers and packers can produce similar shapes — but it precludes confirming the package's actual runtime behavior, and the package's declared purpose (array utility / nodepull) does not justify hiding its source. Without de-obfuscation, it is not possible to verify whether the code performs network I/O, environment access, lifecycle-time execution, or other installer-affecting actions. Recommend human review and de-obfuscation before trusting installation.
